title: Chime cues at breath phase changes (chime theme: deep improvement)
description: Chime at each breath phase start (inhale high, exhale low, hold a neutral third) and at each round end, layered over the sound bed and gated by the sound switch. Lap: temp_job_chime-phase-cues. Result: merged in PR #7 (squash a7d3d15). Owner Pass at Stop 2. The golden echo request came with the Pass and is a new backlog task.

title: Breathwork effect selection (choose an effect instead of Hz)
description: Replace the raw carrier and beat Hz inputs with a choice of effect the user is aiming for. Each effect maps to a preset of carrier and beat range. Wording must not make health or effect claims (documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md; labels describe what is synthesised). Lap: temp_job_breathwork-effects. Result: merged in PR #5 (Calm, Focus, Sleep, Energize presets; Hz behind Advanced; beat trend across the session; speakers pulse instead of gating). Owner Pass at Stop 2.

title: Breathwork sound cues (Web Audio or Tone.js)
description: Second lap of the breathwork timer. Rising soft tone on inhale, falling soft tone on exhale, subtle or silent drone during holds, wired to the sound on/off switch on the settings page (documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md, design direction). Decided at refine: Web Audio API, no new dependency (D11). Binaural beats in headphones mode, isochronic tone in speakers mode. Lap 1 is temp_job_breathwork-timer. Result: merged in PR #4 (binaural headphones mode, isochronic speakers mode, continuous voice with crossfades). Owner Pass at Stop 2.

title: Build breathwork timer app (settings, breathing timer, sound cues)
description: Build the breathwork timer per documentation/DOC_APP_VISION.md (§ Core session flow, § Design direction): a settings page (breaths before hold, inhale/exhale time, hold target, rounds, sound on/off), a breathing timer page with an expanding/contracting circle, round progress, play/pause/stop, sound cues per phase, and the hold progression (1/3, 2/3, full target; fixed 15 s hold). Stack and architecture follow this repo. Starts with loop-refine. Result: merged in PR #2 (lap temp_job_breathwork-timer; route /breathe; live on the Cloudflare preview; owner Pass at Stop 2).

title: Capture app errors to the database
description: Global window error and unhandledrejection handler, error boundary reporting, and the existing logError path, all writing through the deduplicating upsert from the signals backend task. Tag each error with the environment (local, staging, production). Depends on: Signals backend task. Result: merged in PR #28 (src/features/error-reporting; live on production).

title: Signals backend: error logs, feedback and bugs tables
description: Add supabase/migrations with error_logs (clustered by hash, upsert_error_log function), app_feedback and bugs tables, RLS, and a db:push-staging script, so the signal adapter in .agents/skills/loop-backlog/references/signal-adapter.md has data to read. Forks get this by default. Admin = a role claim in the user's auth app_metadata (never user_metadata, which users can edit); admins and local dev can read, signed-in users can insert their own rows. Test it on a scratch Postgres, then apply it to the project; with isolated staging, staging first and production after merge. Result: merged in PR #27 (tables, upsert_error_log, RLS; Google sign-in and production build verified; one shared Supabase project by default, D10).

title: Onboarding states requirements, not methods
description: Rewrite the onboarding gates and the seeded Supabase and hosting tasks so they state setup requirements (end state, why, how the agent verifies, who acts) instead of vendor click paths, and add the staging Supabase project requirement. Lap: documentation/jobs/temp_job_onboarding-requirements/BRIEF.md. Result: merged in PR #26 (onboarding.md states requirements; Supabase and hosting requirement tables; signals epic queued).

title: Run the loop skill evals against the v0.42.0 baseline
description: Deferred from the skill-loop rework (skill-loop D59) to save usage. Run the eval cases under .agents/skills/router/evals/ and .agents/skills/loop-*/evals/ (15 cases), once with the new skill and once with the v0.42.0 skills it replaced (baseline = commit a920c0d), using the skill-creator workflow or `claude plugin eval`. Report pass rates per skill, and fix the skills where the new version loses behavior. Context: documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md § skill-loop. Result: 45/45 graders passed on new skills vs 39/45 on v0.42.0 baseline (composer-2.5); 0 regressions.

title: Show the harness overview on the app's home page and README
description: Publish the designed harness flowchart as an app route (/harness) built from kit components and the bronze theme tokens, with a PNG preview (public/harness-overview.png). Show a welcome card on the home page so visitors on the preview URL and on a fresh first run see it, and put the image at the top of README.md so people arriving from GitHub or Google see it. Result: merged in PR #32 (src/features/harness-overview, route /harness, public/harness-overview.png).
